deviations_and_problems: Windows: signal.SIGALRM missing -> AppWorld.execute timeout fails; worked around with timeout_seconds=None (no per-execution timeout; no hang occurred). Matches public issues #14/#157.

Windows: default cp1252 stdout/encoding raised UnicodeEncodeError inside world.evaluate(); fixed by PYTHONUTF8=1. Matches public issue #28 class. Two smoke tasks failed before this fix; those smoke outputs were discarded and the full run is clean.

IPython tried to use the parent shell VIRTUAL_ENV (a different project venv; only the env var of the child process was overridden, nothing installed/modified there); set VIRTUAL_ENV to the appworld venv for the run. Running with python -I additionally broke the 2nd world creation, so not used for the run.

`appworld install` unpacked the tests bundle to <home>/.appworld/tests (outside the appworld-local directory; AppWorld hard-coded location, not removed). It also unpacked app sources into the venv package dir.

Download from GitHub LFS/data worked natively (no Docker needed). data dir on disk contains all splits including test_normal/test_challenge task folders (732 task dirs); they were NOT opened/listed by name/loaded. Only datasets/train.txt and dev.txt were read via load_task_ids("train"/"dev").

Actual split sizes: train=90, dev=57 (request expected dev=60). Only 5 apps (spotify, phone, venmo, file_system, simple_note) plus supervisor appear in train/dev; amazon, gmail, splitwise, todoist definitions exist in the 457 list but no train/dev task requires them.

AppWorld records only the request in its tracker; response lengths were captured by wrapping Requester._get/_post/_put/_patch/_delete and response_to_json in the runner (monkey-patch, no data modified). Response status 422 occurred 24 times in 11 tasks (reference solution paths, tasks still pass).
Issue notes (note_quote) are short phrases from public issue text, hand-curated for evaluation/environment-related issues, keyword-extracted snippets for others.
Definition lengths computed on {"type","function"} (canary_string key stripped); including the key the totals are in overall_including_canary_key.
Solutions were run once (not twice); AppWorld is deterministic for fixed task data.
